parts.script:
Sarah: Hey, Tom! Have you thought about our weekend trip? I heard the weather is going to be perfect!  
Tom: Yes! I was thinking we could go hiking at Pine Valley. What do you think?  
Sarah: That sounds great! I love hiking there. We should probably leave early to avoid the crowds.  
Tom: Good idea. How about we meet at my place around 7 AM?  
Sarah: That works for me. Should we bring some snacks?  
Tom: Definitely! I can pack some sandwiches and chips. Do you want to bring something sweet?  
Sarah: Sure! I’ll bring some cookies. What about drinks?  
Tom: I’ll take care of the drinks. I can bring water and maybe some soda.  
Sarah: Perfect! I can’t wait! Also, should we check if the park is open?  
Tom: Yes, let me do that. I’ll check online later. Just to be safe!  
Sarah: Sounds like a plan! Let’s finalize everything tonight then.  
Tom: Absolutely! Looking forward to it!
